mapper.insert: insert into attendance_import (file_name, imported_by, total_record, status) values (#{fileName}, #{importedBy}, #{totalRecord}, #{status})
mapper.select: select import_id, file_name, import_date, imported_by, total_record, status from attendance_import where import_id = #{importId}
select import_id, file_name, import_date, imported_by, total_record, status from attendance_import order by import_id desc
